value.account:
CHANGES
- State: RunState.result_persistence_profile (validated at construction/initialize/load, omitted when None); StateManager.initialize(result_persistence_profile=...); an EligiblePureVisitMixin in state.py (shared by StateManager and the call-frame manager) with begin/reuse/settle success/settle failure, each one transaction. fail_run no longer marks a derived pure cursor 'failed' so a crash stays resumable.
- New modules: workflow/pure_replay_shell.py (constants, PureResultReplayIndexError, witness, exact shell, progress classifier), pure_replay_index.py (eligibility, ref->typed-address binding, literal type checks incl. inactive union members, topological order, required_pure_node_ids), pure_result_replay.py (PureReplayRuntime: witnesses, cache with per-hit revalidation, overlay, replay_node, boundary analysis/leaf audit, persisted-surface conflict audit; re-exports the public names).
- Executor: eligible nodes begin/reuse a single visit and settle through OutcomeRecorder(eligible_pure_settlement=...); no bundle write, no checkpoint hook, no publish for them; skips/pre-visit failures of eligible nodes also record their visit so they classify as durable_failure_skip. Resume: pre-prologue surface+progress audit, restart node determined once and passed to ResumePlanner.determine_default_resume_decision(restart_node_id=), pure prefix replayed in memory before the default-resume decision, errors recorded as pure_result_replay_unavailable. Provider observation manager is now created at execute() start and closed once (two existing tests updated for this).
- Calls/CLI: fresh non-iterative Workflow Lisp child frames select the profile from callee provenance; load_existing_call_frame_read_only and rejection of malformed existing frames; run and resume --force-restart select the profile; force-restart no longer writes observability onto the source run.
- Checkpoints: no shadow record for derived pure points, restore payload omits bindings sourced from them, nearest-boundary selection filters them first, and default resume admits the single VALIDATED_FRAME_ENTRY_REPLAY zero-record case (else fails closed with lexical_default_resume_prior_boundary_not_restorable).
- specs/state.md section; tests: tests/test_result_persistence_profile_state.py and tests/test_pure_result_replay.py (74 tests).

VERIFICATION
Full suite before/after: 147 failures with my first pass vs a 138-failure baseline (provider isolation/materialization/nanobragg etc. fail without my change); after fixes the only difference from baseline was one load-dependent fifo test that passes alone. Two provider-observation tests were updated for the lifecycle change.

ALTERNATIVES / DECISIONS
- Considered storing the index on the bundle or runtime plan; rejected (spec says plan is unchanged), so it is derived and cached by object identity.
- Considered keeping the executor default-resume wrapper signature unchanged; instead it passes restart_node_id only to hooks that accept it (inspect.signature) so existing monkeypatched hooks keep working.
- Failing a command effect cannot be used to simulate interruption (command effects are not safely resumable by default), so tests rewind durable state.
- Loop-owned pure nodes report multiple_visit_region (the only ineligibility constant named in the spec); other ineligibility reasons are my own strings (not_compiler_generated, finalization_region, durable_publication).

NOT COVERED / GUESSES
- Signatures the spec left open are guesses: replay_node's evaluate_node is called as evaluate_node(node, overlay_state) and must return an execute_pure_projection-style result; audit_persisted_surfaces calls resolve_bundle_path(node) with a PureReplayNode.
- 'unbound text' is implemented as a literal containing '${' or an unparseable ref; 'durable owner' for the zero-record case is interpreted as the profile plus validated leaves.
- Missing durable effect artifacts surface as binding_unresolved from the evaluator, not durable_input_missing (that is reserved for bound inputs/intrinsics).
- Reports/dashboards that read pure step artifacts from disk state will see shells; not audited. Nested for-each/iteration-owned frames, reachability_ambiguous via real programs, and the profile_conflict checkpoint_record/restore_payload surfaces have no end-to-end tests (checkpoint-record omission is tested; conflict surfaces steps/pure_bundle/private_artifact_versions are).
- No commits were made; docs beyond specs/state.md were not updated.
